name: Aripiprazole lauroxil
summary: Aripiprazole lauroxil, sold under the brand name Aristada among others, is a long-acting injectable atypical antipsychotic that was developed by Alkermes. It is an N-acyloxymethyl prodrug of aripiprazole that is administered via intramuscular injection once every four to eight weeks for the treatment of schizophrenia. Aripiprazole lauroxil was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in October 2015.

pharmacology.text: Aripiprazole exhibits high affinity for serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A receptors, dopamine D2, and dopamine D3. Moderate affinity is exhibited for serotonin 5-HT7, α1-adrenergic, dopamine D4, histamine H1, and serotonin reuptake site. No affinity for cholinergic muscarinic receptors have been found.

uses.text: Aripiprazole lauroxil is indicated for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults. Aripiprazole lauroxil is a longer-lasting and injectable version of the oral antipsychotic aripiprazole.Aripiprazole lauroxil, along with other drugs in its family, are not approved for treatment of the elderly with dementia-related psychosis.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects are akathisia. According to the drug's warning label and safety information, the side effects are large in variety.

fact.en: It is aripiprazole with a lauric acid chain attached, the same fatty acid found in coconut oil. The chain makes the molecule dissolve so slowly that one injection keeps working for weeks.
fact.zh: 它是阿立哌唑接上月桂酸鏈的產物，月桂酸正是椰子油中的那種脂肪酸。這條鏈使分子溶解得極慢，因此一次注射能持續作用數週。
fact.zhHans: 它是阿立哌唑接上月桂酸链的产物，月桂酸正是椰子油中的那种脂肪酸。这条链使分子溶解得极慢，因此一次注射能持续作用数周。
